topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining its learning outcomes and connecting the upcoming material to previous histopathology practicals.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Cellular Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and detail the laboratory assays used to detect cell transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressor Genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer-associated genes and explain how mutations disrupt cellular regulatory pathways like the cell cycle.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the types, underlying repair and replication defects, and cellular consequences of sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Multistep Tumor Progression and Hereditary Cancer Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the stepwise accumulation of mutations during tumorigenesis and illustrate how inherited predispositions alter cancer development and evolution.

topics.label: Conclusion and Course Wrap-Up
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with recommended reading and an outlook on the next session.
